name: Text
author: OpenPen
description: Place text annotations anywhere on screen. Click to type; Enter or click away commits, Esc cancels, Shift+Enter adds a line. Committed text is placed as-is and cannot be re-edited.
changelog: Add a style panel beside the Text button to set font size, font, bold and italic.
Press Ctrl+Alt+T (Command+Option+T on macOS) to switch to the text tool.
Hold Ctrl and scroll the mouse wheel while typing to change the font size.
